Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 1987
EMIGRATION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1987
ACT XI OF 1987
An Act further to amend the Emigration Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 16th November, 1987]
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Emigration
Ordinance, 1979 (XVIII of 1979), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may' be called the
Emigration (Amendment) Act, 1987.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Insertion of new section 24-A, Ordinance XVIII of 1979

ACT XI OF 1987
EMIGRATION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1987
ACT XI OF 1987
An Act further to amend the Emigration Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 16th November, 1987]
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Emigration
Ordinance, 1979 (XVIII of 1979), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
2. Insertion of new section 24-A, Ordinance XVIII of 1979.---In the Emigration Ordinance, 1979
(XVIII of 1979), after section 24, the following new section shall be inserted,
namely:--
"24-A. Appeal.--(1) A person sentenced by a Special Court may. within
forty-five days of the order, prefer an appeal to the High Court.
(2) Where a Special Court has passed an order of acquittal,--
(a) the Federal Government may direct any of its Law Officers to
present an appeal; and
(b) in the case of a prosecution for any offence punishable
under this Ordinance, the person in respect of whom the offence is alleged to
have been committed may, within a period of forty-five days, appeal, to the
High Court against the order.".
